items.title: Dick Katz interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: I went in and I’m scuffling... Brookmeyer. You’re going along... the way he brought the band in.

ctx.x: Oh God. Could you go in and sub for me tonight? I have to write some music for “The Today Show.” That sounded funny to me anyhow. I mean “The Tonight Show.” So I went in and I’m scuffling, and there was one piece, it’s either “Once Around” or “Three in One,” Brookmeyer. You’re going along, it’s a very abstract piece, and all of a sudden the band stops. Silence. And it says on the part “Play a solo.” No chords, nothing. Just play. And I had heard guys do that. And most guys like try out everything they ever knew,…
